title_en: The Oppression Suffered by al-Zahra (peace be upon her) as Proof of the Illegitimacy of the Caliphate After the Messenger of God (peace be upon him and his family)

summary: This video by His Eminence, the religious authority (marja') Sayyid Kamal al-Haydari discusses how the historical grievances and oppression faced by Fatima al-Zahra (peace be upon her) serve as evidence against the legitimacy of the post-Prophetic caliphate.
